summary: Partners Group Lending Fund, LLC filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 131,244 Class M units for $196,013 and providing its June 30, 2026 net asset value (NAV), portfolio statistics, and commentary. The sale was made to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. This is a routine periodic disclosure of equity sales and NAV, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or strategic review. The filing does not indicate any corporate action affecting shareholders beyond ordinary fundraising activity.
